Regular polygons: Interior angle = (n − 2) · 180° / n, exterior angle = 360° / n, and the sum of interior angles is (n − 2) · 180°.
Inscribed and circumscribed circles: A regular polygon has circumradius R and inradius r with the same center. Use a = 2R sin(180° / n), r = R cos(180° / n), and S = (1/2) P r.
Circumference and arc length: C = 2πr, and an arc of α degrees has length πrα / 180.
Area of a circle and of a sector: S = πr², a sector has area πr²α / 360, and a ring has area π(R² − r²).
